lowres_ok.result: no larger copy; the film is full 1920x1080 at 20 Mbps and the 'missing rows' are its black studio background, not letterbox bars; block ratios 1.04 to 1.18

note: Nintendo Japan topics, 29 Oct (relay 01:02Z): the Nintendo Switch 2 The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition (Japanese-language model, Japan), the Switch 2 Pro Controller Zelda edition with display stand, and the Zelda carrying case with screen protector go on sale today at retailers across Japan; Triforce motif with pixel-art Link and Zelda hidden in the design; stock may run out at some stores. Nintendo Life (Direct, Sep 2026): US $519.99 console, launch 29 Oct; not in the primary, so on screen no price, only 'Gulf price not announced' (tbreak: UAE pricing and availability not announced). Footage: Nintendo Japan's product film on the edition page (zelda_thumb.mp4, 1920x1080 60 fps, 20 Mbps, no audio, decode clean): Joy-Con close-ups, the console's back with the Triforce pattern, the three crests and the golden Triforce. Sound: our bed (the film has no sound track).
